import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
cameras = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Map sensor types to a more interpretable categorization
sensor_type_map = {
    'Micro 4/3': 'Micro Four Thirds',
    'APS-C': 'APS-C Sensor',
    'Full Frame': 'Full Frame Sensor'
}
cameras['sensor_type'] = cameras['sensor_type'].map(sensor_type_map)

# Map lens mounts to a more interpretable categorization
lens_mount_map = {
    'E': 'EF Mount',
    'EF': 'EF Mount',
    'MFT': 'Micro Four Thirds Mount'
}
cameras['lens_mount'] = cameras['lens_mount'].map(lens_mount_map)

# Set up the figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a bar chart of camera prices by brand
sns.set_style('whitegrid')
plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
sns.barplot(x='brand', y='price_usd', data=cameras)
plt.title('Camera Prices by Brand')
plt.xlabel('Brand')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')

# Create a histogram of megapixels
plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
sns.histplot(cameras['megapixels'], bins=10, kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Megapixels')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')

# Layout so plots do not overlap
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
cameras = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Map sensor types to a more interpretable categorization
sensor_type_map = {
    'Micro 4/3': 'Micro Four Thirds',
    'APS-C': 'APS-C Sensor',
    'Full Frame': 'Full Frame Sensor'
}
cameras['sensor_type'] = cameras['sensor_type'].map(sensor_type_map)

# Map lens mounts to a more interpretable categorization
lens_mount_map = {
    'E': 'EF Mount',
    'EF': 'EF Mount',
    'MFT': 'Micro Four Thirds Mount'
}
cameras['lens_mount'] = cameras['lens_mount'].map(lens_mount_map)

# Set up the figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a bar chart of camera prices by brand
sns.set_style('whitegrid')
plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
sns.barplot(x='brand', y='price_usd', data=cameras)
plt.title('Camera Prices by Brand')
plt.xlabel('Brand')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')

# Create a histogram of megapixels
plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
sns.histplot(cameras['megapixels'], bins=10, kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Megapixels')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')

# Layout so plots do not overlap
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
